_readme: Generic agent config. 'investigation_chains' defines, per seed node label, which multi-hop path to walk -- this is exactly the 'deviation -> equipment -> related past CAPAs -> applicable regulation clause' chain from the project brief, made declarative/config-driven instead of hardcoded. Add a new chain for a new label without touching agent.py.

answer_template._readme: Deterministic (non-LLM) synthesis is the default -- every line in the answer is directly traceable to a doc_id/locator or a graph node id, which is what 'citation grounding' in the brief requires. An LLM phrasing pass is optional (see agent.py --llm) and is PURELY COSMETIC rewording on top of this already-grounded content -- it is not allowed to introduce new facts, per its own system prompt in agent.py.
